findings.reason: A bounded red test showed an over-limit diff could leave a proposed record before the caller received file_too_large. Diff validation now precedes all private object/record writes, and the regression asserts both store directories remain empty.

A bounded red test showed create cleanup failure after a successful exclusive link was reported as zero-effect conflict even though the target existed. The mutation bit is now set immediately after replace/link, so later cleanup or fsync failures report file_recovery_required with effect_disposition=applied and preserve the writer claim.

The final suite exposed a test assertion that replayed an unchanged record and expected a quota error at exact capacity. The implementation correctly allows projected size == max_bytes; the regression now uses a larger recovery record and verifies the rejection boundary.
